## Personality

Joshua Pye is a surly and taciturn individual. He possesses an unsociable nature and deeply values his independence.

## History

Following a mix-up with paint order numbers, the village hall was painted a glaring blue rather than the intended green. News of the error spread and devastated the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). While the villagers ultimately rallied behind the young people involved, they placed the blame for the mistake on the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes).

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P25](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0025), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040)_
